title: Proof becomes a threshold
governingQuestion: When a show schedule has an evidence threshold, what exactly has—and has not—been verified?
status: evidence-backed production draft; recording, interviews, specialist review and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: Proof becomes a threshold
longform.opening: A Copenhagen runway begins before the room: with a file that must clear an admission threshold.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: CPHFW introduced its framework in 2020 and has required applicants to document compliance with Minimum Standards for official schedule consideration since January 2023.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: For SS27, the organizer says 34 show and presentation brands were reviewed by its show committee and a Rambøll-led sustainability committee against 19 Minimum Standards.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: CPHFW states that its process validates submitted information but is not a certification scheme or audit; admission must not be restated as proof that a brand or product is sustainable.

longform.closing: Copenhagen’s distinction is not a claim of purity. It is the decision to make participation depend on evidence—and the obligation to keep asking what that evidence cannot establish.

spokenScript: A Copenhagen runway begins before the room: with a file that must clear an admission threshold.
CPHFW introduced its framework in 2020 and has required applicants to document compliance with Minimum Standards for official schedule consideration since January 2023.
For SS27, the organizer says 34 show and presentation brands were reviewed by its show committee and a Rambøll-led sustainability committee against 19 Minimum Standards.
The system: application, committee review, 19 Minimum Standards.
The boundary: CPHFW states that its process validates submitted information but is not a certification scheme or audit; admission must not be restated as proof that a brand or product is sustainable.
